title: SLO Quilt: stitch-model-route latency with streaming/non-streaming seams
creator: Riley Chen
description: Problem: Teams lack a single, intuitive board that shows p50/p95/p99 latency across model variants and API routes while cleanly separating streaming vs non-streaming I/O. Current dashboards are many small panels spread across dashboards and don’t include trace hooks for streaming flows, making investigations slow and error-prone. Goal: Deliver a compact "SLO Quilt" board that visualizes per-model/per-route latency percentiles with streaming/non-streaming seams, includes quick links to traces and exemplar requests, and is powered by a unified metric and log pipeline (io_mode tagging). This ticket coordinates telemetry schema changes, trace hook instrumentation, dashboard panels, alert thresholds, and rollout steps.
acceptance_criteria: Unified metrics: every request has 'model', 'route', 'io_mode' (streaming|nonstreaming), 'servepath' tags in metrics and logs
Dashboard panels showing p50/p95/p99 by model and route with a clear streaming vs non-streaming split
Each cell in the quilt links to a pre-filtered trace view and a representative request sample when available
Backfill or derived metrics created for the last 90 days to enable trend comparisons
Playbook: documented runbook for identifying regressions with example query recipes
No regressions to existing SLO alerts after rollout (validated in staging)
tasks: Telemetry schema: add 'io_mode' enum to metric/log envelope and update ingestion pipeline producers
Tracing hooks: add stream-capable trace spans around the streaming emitter and KV cache accesses
Metrics: create aggregated p50/p95/p99 series partitioned by (model, route, io_mode)
Backfill: run derived aggregation jobs for 90d window and store in analytics table
Dashboard: design UI mock and build SLO Quilt panels and cross-links to traces
Alerts: propose and validate alert thresholds for p95 and p99 tail regressions
Docs: write short runbook and how-to investigate a tile failure
Rollout: staged deployment and canary in dedicated, then hosted
telemetry_queries: ClickHouse SQL (p95 by model/route/io_mode): SELECT model, route, io_mode, quantileExact(0.95)(lat_ms) AS p95 FROM requests_raw WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY model, route, io_mode
PromQL (derived p99 counter): histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route, io_mode))
Trace link generator: /traces?query=service:runtime AND trace.tags.model={{model}} AND trace.tags.route={{route}} AND trace.tags.io_mode={{io_mode}}&sort=duration_desc
Representative sample selector: SELECT * FROM requests_raw WHERE model = '{model}' AND route = '{route}' AND io_mode = '{io_mode}' ORDER BY latency DESC LIMIT 1
